integrity: Primary Fourier identities and proof steps from earlier work are credited; n=3 coverage is explicitly acknowledged as prior. No authorship or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to odd n>=3 with characteristic of F_q coprime to n; neither modular nor even-order cases nor noncyclic Alexander quandles are classified. Exhaustive tests cover fourteen instances; the proof is symbolic. Historical priority beyond accessed records is not independently certified.
title: Exact finite-field idempotent counts for all odd dihedral quandle algebras
